title: *West Bank and Gaza Country Climate and Development Report*
geographic_coverage: West Bank and Gaza with city/subregional analysis
temporal_coverage: Historical climate through 2020; projections to 2055/2090; socioeconomic evidence mainly pre-2023
methodology: CMIP6/SSP projections, sector modelling, World Bank socioeconomic and institutional analysis
limitations: Predates the October 2023 conflict and subsequent transformation of Gaza; some sector estimates are model-based. PDF p.2 permits noncommercial reproduction with attribution, subject to any further third-party permissions; not an unrestricted CC licence.

title: *The State of Palestine’s First Nationally Determined Contributions - Updated Submission*
methodology: National policy process; sector implementation action plans; costing and institutional arrangements
limitations: Policy commitments and targets, not independently demonstrated outcomes; predates post-2023 destruction.

title: *Conflict and social vulnerability to climate change: lessons from Gaza*
organization: Mason, Zeitoun & el Sheikh; *Climate and Development*
geographic_coverage: Gaza Strip; stakeholder evidence centred on Gaza City
methodology: Interviews, questionnaire, workshops and cognitive mapping; 12 stakeholder representatives in key workshops
limitations: Small qualitative sample; important political actors excluded/unavailable; very old relative to 2026 conditions; no causal identification. Author-uploaded published full text was inspected on ResearchGate. LSE institutional metadata confirms the 2011 publication; its accepted-version PDF could not be fetched. Author upload is not redistribution permission.

title: *Compounding Vulnerability: Impacts of Climate Change on Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank*
organization: Mason, Zeitoun & Mimi; *Journal of Palestine Studies*
geographic_coverage: Gaza and selected West Bank localities
methodology: Analysis of UNDP consultations and supporting literature/case evidence
limitations: Qualitative and interpretive; locality-specific; pre-2023 and not a national causal study. Published full article inspected at Columbia's journal archive. The opening notice reserves all rights and directs reproduction-permission requests to the publisher.

title: *The political economy of water and sanitation in Palestine’s Gaza Strip: A scoping review*
methodology: Scoping review of 17 peer-reviewed and 37 grey-literature sources
limitations: Heterogeneous literature, much of it low-to-moderate direct relevance; political-economy synthesis rather than causal impact evaluation. Article copyright notice explicitly grants Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

title: *ICR Review: Water Supply & Sewage System Improvement (P101289)*
methodology: Independent desk review of implementation completion evidence and results framework
limitations: Pre-2023; some outcome data weak; focused on one WASH project, not climate adaptation as a whole.

title: *Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment - Gaza Strip, April 2026*
organization: World Bank, United Nations and European Union
methodology: Remote sensing, ground-verified information and standard RDNA damage/loss/needs methodology across 17 sectors
limitations: Access constraints required substantial remote assessment; authors call for later on-the-ground sector assessments; conflict damage is not climate damage. The World Bank metadata page and continuous official UN executive-summary extract were inspected; direct UN PDF fetch returned 403 and UNmissions fetch was unavailable. No claim of full-PDF inspection; the WASH-needs table figure was removed.

title: *Economic Update on the West Bank and Gaza*
geographic_coverage: West Bank and Gaza, separately where data permit
temporal_coverage: Information through end-Apr 2026; principal economic data through 2025/Q1 2026
methodology: Macro-fiscal, labour, financial, energy and social-sector monitoring drawing on official and partner data
limitations: Rapidly changing conflict/access context; economic monitoring, not a climate or impact evaluation.

title: *Humanitarian Situation Report - 23 July 2026*
geographic_coverage: Gaza and West Bank; detailed West Bank localities
temporal_coverage: West Bank reporting primarily 14-20 Jul 2026; cumulative indicators
methodology: OCHA/cluster operational reporting, incident monitoring and partner data
limitations: Humanitarian monitoring rather than causal research; data can be revised; politically sensitive claims require attribution. Report title/reference date is 23 July 2026; webpage display date is 25 July 2026.

title: *Humanitarian Situation Update - Analysis of the Response to the Needs of Children at Mid-year 2026*
methodology: UNICEF operational monitoring and partner/sector estimates
limitations: Humanitarian operational estimates; no climate attribution or counterfactual evaluation.

title: *Gaza Strip: Acute Food Insecurity Situation for 16 April-30 June 2026 and Projection for 1 July-31 December 2026*
limitations: Projection depends on scenario assumptions; improvement attributed by IPC to assistance is synthesis, not randomized causal evaluation.

title: *UNICEF in the State of Palestine Humanitarian Situation Update - The West Bank*
geographic_coverage: West Bank including East Jerusalem; Area C/Jordan Valley emphasis
limitations: Webpage publication metadata and stated reporting period are inconsistent; humanitarian estimates rather than climate-specific research. Reporting period 30 April 2026 governs use of its figures; no publication-day inference was made.
